sloka: तस्मिन् काले स धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।कुम्भकर्णवधे युक्तो योगान् परिमृशन् बहून् ।। ६.६७.११५ ।।
transliteration: tasmin kāle sa dharmātmā lakṣmaṇo vākyamabravīt।kumbhakarṇavadhe yukto yogān parimṛśan bahūn ।। 6.67.115 ।।

translations.english: "O Hero! that heroism you have acquired is irresistible even by Indra is true. Now your prowess has been witnessed. Rama stands here, immovable like a mountain."
